mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 64 degrees at Verona Area High School, plus a beautiful full moon tonight, though the air quality index is currently at a moderate 55.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest where students submitted 53 designs across four age categories, and community members can now vote for their favorites online or at City Hall through August 7 to determine the official designs for the November election.

Today is full of great ways to get out, including the Farmers Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and Wednesday pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, while tomorrow we can look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School and more trivia at Hop Haus.

In a look at the weekly report, officers handled a noteworthy incident on July 26 when a 55 year old driver was arrested for a first offence O W I after being pulled over for driving 97 miles per hour on the highway.
Make sure to stop by for today's Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor, which you can enjoy once the doors open at 10 AM.
